text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Duramente's running was overwhelming. 
But she's getting too heated again...! 
"Duramente!!" I shouted her name with everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
She caught herself on the very edge of losing control, and 
Duramente made her strength plain and took the win.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
After the race she said my voice had reached her. 
That was surely... because she believed in me. 
Thank you for believing in me, I told her, and meant it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
But her drive isn't satisfied. 
She resolved to grow in spirit and win 
the Japan Derby with a perfect run.
